# Jenkins CI/CD Learning Track

Learn continuous integration and delivery using Jenkins.

## Structure
- `01-hello-pipeline/` - Basic declarative pipeline syntax
- `02-stages-and-steps/` - Multi-stage build, test, and deploy flow
- `03-environment-and-credentials/` - Handling environment variables and secrets
- `04-post-actions/` - Success, failure, and always notifications
